packageRules.description: Auto-merge everything short of a major bump (digest, pin, patch, minor). These deploy via Portainer GitOps polling once merged. Majors and Plex are held back by the rules below, which must stay after this one to override it.
Group all LinuxServer.io images into one PR to reduce noise. Plex is excluded so it gets its own reviewable PR.

LinuxServer.io tags carry a per-build suffix (-lsNNN, plus a git hash on plex: 1.43.3.10896-<githash>-ls321). Renovate's default docker versioning only compares tags with a byte-identical suffix, so the changing rebuild counter made every newer tag look incompatible and these images were silently never offered an update. Loose versioning orders the numeric parts correctly. BUT loose alone is dangerous: it treats ANY tag starting with digits as a version, so on 2026-08-31 it proposed sonarr 4.0.19.2979-ls322 -> 5.14 (Sonarr v2 on Mono 5.14, built 2021 — took Sonarr down), bazarr -> 438eee94-ls46 (git hash), prowlarr -> 2.6.3-nightly, nzbget -> 26.3.20260827. allowedVersions is what makes loose safe: it restricts candidates to real LinuxServer build tags, i.e. a dotted numeric version, an optional git hash, an optional -rN, then -lsNNN. Verified against the live tag lists: it matches every tag pinned here and rejects 5.14, 5.14-2.0.0.5344-ls15, 438eee94-ls46, 2.6.3-nightly, 26.3.20260827, 4.1.3, develop, latest and nightly. If a LinuxServer tag format ever changes, the image goes quiet rather than jumping to a wrong tag — check the Dependency Dashboard if one stops updating. Radarr is deliberately absent: it pins the plain upstream tag (6.3.0), which default docker versioning already handles.

n8n ships its beta line as plain semver (`next`/`beta` was 2.37.4 while `latest`/`stable` was 2.36.8), so a version comparison cannot tell a stable release from a pre-release and would auto-merge onto beta. Do NOT try to fix that with followTag: `followTag: "stable"` was tried here and Renovate reports `Can't find version with tag stable for docker package n8nio/n8n`, then finds no updates at all — it silently freezes n8n, which is worse than the problem. So n8n is Renovate-managed but never auto-merged: check the proposed version against n8n's releases (is it on the stable channel yet?) and merge by hand.
Require manual review for major bumps (e.g. Radarr v5->v6) which can need data migrations.

A postgres major is a dump/restore, not a tag change — the server refuses to start on a data directory written by an older major, so merging the bump just breaks the stack. Renovate raised #186 (n8n 15->18) and #199 (paperless 16->18) and would keep re-raising them forever, so majors are disabled for both. Minor/patch still flow. Re-enable this deliberately, at the same time as doing the migration. immich pins its own ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres (vectorchord build) and is NOT covered here — it needs immich's own documented upgrade path.

Plex is Renovate-managed but never auto-merged: the plex stack has no GitOps polling, so merging a bump only changes the repo and the new image needs a manual Pull and redeploy in Portainer. Review and merge the PR by hand, then redeploy.
